rationale: xgb_adv_val sweep #610-617 has plateaued at 5/7 (#610 best). xgb_meta_label is structurally novel (first hierarchical-classifier trainer where stage-1 score is an INPUT FEATURE to stage 2) and shows the right kind of WR uplift at default HP — W1 thr=0.40 hit WR=58% n=19 ann=+15%, W6 thr=0 hit WR=47% dd=2.3%. Both miss the n>=20 cliff by 1-3 trades. Sweep target: lower stage1/stage2 learning_rate × more n_estimators × wider stage1_train_frac to spread the score distribution and pull these high-WR threshold bands above n=20.
